name: Taiwa (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Taiwa town emblem in white: an angular stylised letter T-shaped device.
history: Municipal flag of Taiwa, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 August 1975.

features.role: Taiwa town emblem — an angular stylised letter T-shaped device
